avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction reduces pomalidomide plasma concentrations and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative herbal supplements

avoid_supplements.name: Grapefruit seed extract
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase pomalidomide levels and adverse effects
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid or use with caution; monitor for toxicity

avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Vitamin E (>400 IU/day)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potential additive anticoagulant/antiplatelet effects; pomalidomide increases VTE risk
avoid_supplements.action: Limit to RDA; discuss with prescriber before supplementing

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin K
caution_supplements.mechanism: May interact with anticoagulation management in VTE prevention strategies
caution_supplements.action: Maintain consistent intake; inform healthcare team of supplementation

caution_supplements.name: Turmeric/Curcumin
caution_supplements.mechanism: Weak CYP3A4 inhibition; theoretical risk of increased pomalidomide levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor clinical response; report any increased side effects

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases pomalidomide bioavailability and toxicity risk
avoid_foods.action: Completely avoid grapefruit products during treatment

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase pomalidomide absorption; take consistently with or without food
caution_foods.action: Maintain consistent meal timing relative to dosing; avoid variable fat intake

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase hepatic metabolism burden and GI side effects
caution_foods.action: Limit alcohol consumption; monitor for increased nausea or hepatic effects

monitoring_notes: Monitor for thromboembolic events (VTE risk is high with pomalidomide); assess for increased peripheral neuropathy and hematologic toxicity. Verify no concurrent CYP3A4 inhibitors/inducers and counsel on strict adherence to teratogenic precautions (FDA REMS program).
